review_notes: I read the whole file. It builds the additive structure on ArchimedeanClass R (Zero, Add, SMul ℕ and ℤ, Neg, AddCommMonoid, LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop, LinearOrderedAddCommGroupWithTop) and defines an AddValuation through the existing AddValuation.of. It also contains many lemmas about order homomorphisms from Archimedean rings. The SMul ℕ and ℤ instances are needed to supply nsmul and zsmul fields compatibly with `mk_pow` and `mk_zpow`. `addValuation` is a named wrapper over the existing AddValuation API, which the rubric excludes. I found no independent Mathlib declaration representing the same concept. A grep for AddValuation under Mathlib/Algebra/Order showed only the file's own definition and one use in StandardPart.lean. The remaining items are standalone theorems, which the rubric excludes. I found no justified finding. My search was limited to this grep and a read of the file, so I may have missed a competing declaration elsewhere in Mathlib.
